label: Betalning — Stripe
summary: Hosted Stripe Checkout for ONE-TIME payments (mode: payment; a recurring Price fails loudly, never a silent subscription). Adds a server route that creates checkout sessions plus a client button that redirects to Stripe's hosted page — no browser Stripe SDK. CheckoutButton needs a real `price_…` id from the owner's Stripe dashboard: never invent one, and keep it in a single named constant that is easy to find and edit. Demo mode (mock: visual): without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY the route returns 503 'payments-not-configured' and the button opens an honest demo modal. Webhooks are out of scope.
summarySv: Ta betalt med kort via Stripe Checkout. Du behöver två saker från Stripe: en hemlig nyckel och ett pris-id (`price_…`) för varje sak du säljer. Utan den hemliga nyckeln körs betalknappen i demoläge: besökaren ser hela betalflödet men inga pengar dras, och en tydlig demoruta förklarar hur Stripe kopplas in. Saknas i stället ett riktigt pris-id går betalningen fram till Stripe och misslyckas där — fyll i pris-id:t innan du säljer på riktigt.

envVars.purpose: Server-side Stripe API authentication. Find it in the Stripe dashboard under Developers > API keys. Tagged 'feature-runtime' (like resend-contact-form): the checkout-session route instantiates the Stripe client lazily AFTER the env guard, so a missing key degrades to 503 'payments-not-configured' + IntegrationConfigNotice instead of blocking the F3 build or crashing the deploy.

NOT read by this dossier: hosted Checkout redirects from the server route, so no browser Stripe SDK runs and the button works without this key. Only needed if the site later adds Stripe.js/Elements itself. Safe to expose; harmless placeholder OK.

configInputs.label: One-time Stripe Price
configInputs.purpose: Use the owner's real one-time Stripe Price id, stored once in named project code and passed to CheckoutButton. Never invent a price id; this value is not an env key or readiness evidence.

providerSetup.title: Choose the Stripe account and key
providerSetup.instruction: Use the owner's intended test or live Stripe account and store its server secret key in project configuration. Never put it in browser code.

providerSetup.title: Create the one-time Price
providerSetup.instruction: The owner creates the product and one-time Price in the same Stripe account, then supplies its real id for the project's checkout button.
